currentStep: Migration 048 applied: name/target_per_day/uc_names on daily_assignments, supervisor role, assigned_cities on staff. Types updated. Docs updated.
keyDecisions: Batch = assignment. No new table. daily_assignments gets name, target_per_day, uc_names.
Batch naming: {City}-B{seq} (e.g. Sargodha-B1). Global per-city counter, never resets.
Start date = first delivered_at in batch. No start_date column needed.
Monthly refresh: admin clicks Refresh — deletes pending items, inserts fresh from lifecycle.
Batch is permanent but staff can change. Admin reassigns by updating staff_id.
Supervisor role: creates batches, full read-only access (no settings, no revoke). City-scoped.
No revoke for supervisor — admin only.
Manage tab grouped by UC (unchanged). Batch name shown as a column.
